blocks.title: Connect the setting to the label

blocks.content: Find the **Memory** gauge and notice the B suffix beside its value.

steps.description: Click here to open the panel menu.
Click Edit to open the panel editor.

blocks.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid Standard options Unit field property editor']

blocks.content:
The **Memory** panel formats its numeric value as bytes. B means bytes; larger values can use units such as KiB or MiB. Unit formatting changes the display, not the query's data, and doesn't change timestamps into byte values.

Switching the unit to percent wouldn't turn these byte values into a percentage of memory. The numbers would stay the same and be labeled incorrectly. The unit has to describe what the query returns.
